-- Spec only: bodies are placeholders until Phase 2.

-- True only for a bare file name: no separators, no "..", not empty.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex is_plain_name("notes.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  name != "" and name.split("/").len() == 1 and name.split("\\").len() == 1 and name.split("..").len() == 1

-- Returns the text of notes/name, or "" for an unsafe, missing, or unreadable name.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post is_plain_name(name) or out == ""
  if not is_plain_name(name)
    return ""
  var text = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    text = fs.read(name) else ""
  text
